input.item: R2D TBS and D2R TBS encoding

vectors.note: The scheduling-info text spells out the 'first codepoint = first value' rule, so D2R TBS 1..125 is codepoint 0..124. The R2D TBS field (message header) says only 'the value can be {1..125} byte(s)'. These vectors take it as the direct binary value; if the field is also offset by one, every mac_pack/mac_parse vector except Access Trigger changes in the 7 TBS bits. Not resolvable from the text.
